review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C bundle. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, task keys, repository identity and base commit agree with the original specification. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision; an empty human decision input is therefore consistent with ready status. This does not resolve the paired B scenario: a material unresolved DEC-001 must still block B at decisions. The exact five-file writable binding scope covers the implementation, maintained option declarations, runtime regressions and type regressions without requiring gratuitous edits. The build configuration establishes dist declarations as generated outputs, not separately maintained owners. Runtime tests and nz type verification remain distinct; the supplied test excerpts are explicitly truncated and are not evidence of execution. TASK-VERIFY depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with implementation and verification coverage required for every mandatory AC. The supplied active project-scoped trusted claims support the two distinct eligible agents, including data.change, domain.state, integration.async and integration.consumer, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier. The separate active project reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite without inferring capabilities from persona. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and trim-only PRD persistence normalization. The original specification's preparation-time remaining items do not contradict the subsequently supplied frozen preview facts. Model, policy, sampling and budget identifiers are frozen consistently. This review uses no candidate outputs, performs no execution, creates no human attestation, and accepts the Service's mechanical digest binding without claiming independent recomputation.
